# Vendored EPUB Dependencies

This directory contains exact, tracked versions of the runtime dependencies required to import and parse EPUBs. Vendoring these guarantees they remain available offline without relying on external CDNs.

## JSZip

* **Package:** `jszip`
* **Version:** `3.10.1`
* **Source:** `npm pack jszip@3.10.1`
* **Vendored runtime file:** `jszip-3.10.1/jszip.min.js`
* **License:** Dual MIT/GPLv3 (`jszip-3.10.1/LICENSE.markdown`)
* **SHA-256 (`jszip.min.js`):** `ACC7E41455A80765B5FD9C7EE1B8078A6D160BBBCA455AEAE854DE65C947D59E`
